post.description:
Note:This is the Post Request of Charge CashTicket.


Total amount should be equal to total number of all payment amounts.


Ticket ID may only be used once. 
 
    {
           "siteCode": 123456,      
           "posName": "string",
           "ticketId": "230531001",
           "posLocation": "Restaurant",
           "reservationDetailId": "string",
           "ticketURL":"https://ticket.winston.com/hfaohqowhfoqhfoqhfoh",
           "products": [ 
           {
               "name": "Espresso",
               "amountInclVAT": 300,
               "vatPercentage": 9,
               "quantity": 1,
               "revenueGroupDescription": "Coffee",
               "revenueGroup": "string",
               "revenueGroupId":"121",
               "orderedAt": "2023-05-17T09:08:39.702Z"
            }],           
           "payments": [
               {
                   "paymentAmount": 1050,
                   "name": "Cash",
                   "paymentType": "Cash",
                   "paymentReference": "test3",
                   "paymentMadeAt": "2023-05-30T15:12:18
                     .3730051+05:30"
               }],
              "total": 2350,
              "createdAt": "2023-05-18T09:08:39.702Z",
              "allowDuplicateTickets":true,
    }
    
Example response:
   
      {
       
                   "result": {
                       "bookingId": 16484791
                   },
                   "siteCode": 181914,
                   "success": true,
                   "status": "Processed",
                   "errors": [],
                   "warnings": [],
                  "identifier": "14ebf2e2-e4af-4fdc-98da-58fa03332751"
               
      }

parameters.name: key
parameters.description:
The unique Search Key identifier {Room,Reservation,Name,Guestid,Session,Void, Any}
            

<remarks>
            Note:search key abbrivations Room => RoomNumber,Reservation => ReservationNumber or ReservationNumber-subNumber ,Session => Reservationdetailid, Any=> Room Number, Reservation Number and Guest Name, Group/ Reservation Name.
            </remarks>

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The unique Search Value identifier {123,12345,"JOE",12345,133 or 133-1,67899}
